integrity: The exact tail and optimizer are proved analytically; the standalone finite checker is corroborative only and provides no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted iid continuous inputs on a fixed compact interval; two affine regression parameters only.
The optimum concerns the leading extreme-tail coefficient and not every finite probability threshold or mean-risk criterion.
The quadratic loss matrix is fixed and positive definite; weighted, adaptive, dependent or atomic designs are not analyzed.
Specialized earlier literature could affect novelty priority; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: A universal tail-optimal sampling law for affine least squares
